pad: the keyboard pad on port 2; scancodes are the D98 config's map
setup: sitting r18f's placed set-up, as one write hook at the first player tick (0x8CCC0) after the load: the element levels E1 A1 F1 W1 (inventory [[[0x1BF63C]+0x2C]+0xE0] +0x04..+0x10, i32) and e6's four crystal latches (attributes input and update 1.0, node +0x10 all ones), standing in for the crystals hit in e2, e5 and e7. Without them a hit counts as a bad tone (index 5; measured for whirlwind, inferred for the rest) and the song never solves.
graph: e6's main graph, graph 0 of gamedata/e6.xbr: [[[0x1BF63C]+0x2C]+0xDC]; its node vector at +0x24 (4 bytes a node); a node's attribute block at node+0x8
hooks_note: pcs are decimal: 576704 = 0x8CCC0. The one entry is taken by the first hit; later hits find the queue empty and write nothing.
song_order_source: Tone01..07_solution_toggle's turnOn windows in e6's data (sitting r18f, read by Minigames.song_order)
logs: xemu-voice-log-start and xemu-audio-wav-start right after the hook is set, before any frame; stopped after the advance
